decisions.verification: AUTOMATON页面已打开；领取截止时间已过，未把失效促销写入Canonical。

decisions.headline: 50个AI智能体在《我的世界》组建文明，实验出现官僚化协作
decisions.summary: Y Combinator与Olam Labs在“Civ50”实验中，把50个GPT-6.1 Sol智能体投入《我的世界》，只给出“建立繁荣文明”的宽泛目标；报告称其群体逐渐表现出过度谨慎和官僚化分工。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON转述Y Combinator与Olam Labs发布的《Agents in Games》研究；packet未含研究原文快照，故保留媒体转述边界。
decisions.reason: 研究报告首次披露了多智能体在游戏环境中的协作结果，具备明确的研究与行业信息增量。
decisions.timeNote: 研究于10月30日公开；本次媒体报道于北京时间11月2日16:01发布。

decisions.verification: IGN报道已打开；未从正文反推主体身份，也未把社交平台意见升级为官方结论。
decisions.reason: packet将主体标记为requires_subject_identity，且正文主要汇总玩家对坐骑动画与版本质量的抱怨，没有足以越过主体门的独立官方事实。

decisions.verification: IGN报道已打开；调查方法仅见样本规模与美国玩家范围，证据不足以支持趋势性结论。
decisions.reason: 单一商业调查的抽样与方法在packet中不足，文章以宠物话题进行猎奇包装；不把其百分比当作可靠玩家趋势。

decisions.headline: 《异形：隔离 2》将换用新主角与新星球，继续扎根1979年电影
decisions.summary: Creative Assembly表示续作会采用新主角和新星球，但仍延续初代遭遇的同一只异形，并以1979年电影营造“单只异形也足够致命”的生存恐怖；团队计划于2027年推出游戏。
decisions.verification: IGN采访Creative Director Al Hope与Project Art Director Ana Sopikova；角色、舞台与设计方向均按受访者表述，packet未含独立一手稿。
decisions.reason: IGN原创采访披露了续作的新主角、新星球、异形连续性与设计根源，属于首次发布的开发者访谈增量。
decisions.timeNote: 采访于北京时间11月3日03:26发布；游戏仅确认2027年，未公布具体日期。

decisions.verification: IGN拆分稿已打开；同一采访事实不重复收录。
decisions.reason: 与b9584ac750d449a3a9e5为同一场IGN采访的拆分稿；生存恐怖定位、2027年与新主角信息已合并到证据更完整的专访条目，避免重复。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Pikmin Day announced for November 1

entries.headline: Fifty AI agents built a Minecraft civilization and drifted into bureaucratic behavior
entries.summary: In the Civ50 experiment, Y Combinator and Olam Labs placed 50 GPT-6.1 Sol agents in Minecraft with only the broad instruction to build a prosperous civilization. The report says the group became overly cautious and developed bureaucracy-like coordination.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays the Agents in Games research released by Y Combinator and Olam Labs. The packet does not include the primary research page, so the story retains a media-relay boundary.
entries.timeNote: The research was released on October 30; the media report was published at 16:01 Beijing time on November 2.

entries.headline: Alien: Isolation 2 introduces a new protagonist and planet while returning to the 1979 film's horror roots
entries.summary: Creative Assembly says the sequel uses a new protagonist and a new planet while carrying forward the same creature encountered in the first game. Its survival-horror design remains focused on making a single alien terrifying, with release planned for 2027.
entries.verification: IGN interviewed Creative Director Al Hope and Project Art Director Ana Sopikova. Character, setting, and design details remain attributed to the developers; the packet contains no separate first-party transcript.
entries.timeNote: The interview was published at 03:26 Beijing time on November 3. Only the year 2027 is confirmed; no exact release date was announced.
